name: fps-cv-mcp
description: MCP server that serves Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's CV as a resource for AI systems with comprehensive analysis and summarization tools
long_description: A comprehensive MCP Bundle that exposes Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's curriculum vitae through multiple MCP tools and resources. This server provides access to the CV in markdown format, PDF links, Google Scholar profile, and includes sophisticated summarization capabilities with configurable parameters for different audiences and contexts. The server supports both local (stdio) and remote (streamable-http) deployment modes, making it suitable for various integration scenarios.

tools.name: get_cv
tools.description: Retrieve Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's full CV. Supports 'markdown' (default, LLM-readable) and 'pdf' (original binary document) output formats.

tools.name: refresh_cv
tools.description: Download the latest CV PDF from the main branch on GitHub and rebuild the markdown/section cache without redeploying.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Return a profile or document link by name. Use list_links() to see available names.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List all available profile and document links with their URLs.

tools.name: list_cv_sections
tools.description: List available CV section names with approximate line counts. Helps pick the right section for targeted queries.

tools.name: get_cv_section
tools.description: Retrieve a single named section from the CV by name (case-insensitive). Saves tokens vs fetching the full CV. Lists available sections if the name doesn't match.

tools.name: summarize_cv
tools.description: Generate a customizable summary of Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's CV with configurable parameters for depth, context, emphasis, format, audience, length, and tone. Fallback for clients that do not support Agent Skills; prefer the cv-analyst skill when available.

prompts.name: summary
prompts.text: Configurable prompt for generating CV summaries with extensive customization options for different use cases and audiences
